description: This file is an abstract JUnit test class for testing credentials services within the Eclipse Hono project. It provides shared test logic and utility methods to verify the behavior of credentials management implementations, including setup, retrieval, creation, update, and deletion of device credentials, specifically for different credential types like Password and Psk. It also contains code for creating credentials, verifying password secrets, and ensuring the correct functioning of the underlying services.

classes.name: AbstractCredentialsServiceTest
classes.description: An abstract JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of credentials services and management within the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes test methods for credential retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, and validation, as well as utility methods for constructing credentials and secrets.

methods.name: createPSKCredential
methods.description: Creates a PSK credential with a given authId and psk string.

methods.name: createPasswordCredential
methods.description: Creates a password credential with hashed password, optionally specifying bcrypt iterations.

methods.name: createPlainPasswordCredential
methods.description: Creates a password credential with a plain text password.

methods.name: createPasswordSecret
methods.description: Constructs a PasswordSecret object from a given password, encoding it with bcrypt.

methods.name: verifyPasswordSecret
methods.description: Verifies if a given password matches the stored password secret.

methods.name: assertGetMissing
methods.description: Asserts that credentials are missing for given parameters.

methods.name: assertGetEmpty
methods.description: Asserts that credentials are present but empty.

methods.name: assertGet
methods.description: Validates credentials exist with the expected response.

methods.name: assertResourceVersion
methods.description: Checks that the resource version is set correctly in an operation result.
